title: Batman: The 1980s
subtitle: The main run plus every side book of the decade
credit: Batman #319-442 (Jan 1980 - Dec 1989) read in order, with the Detective Comics and mini-series that run alongside it. Digital coverage: the whole Batman main run is in the library. Detective Comics is only partly digitised - #487-496, 563, 568-591, 595 and 598-603 exist; #497-562 (1982-85) has never had a digital release and #604-607 (The Mud Pack) is print-only. Unofficial fan project.
